title: Why Are Fire Trucks So Long?
description:
Why Are Fire Trucks So Long? A fire truck carries long ladders on top. Some ladders can reach as high as a ten-story building!
A quick trucks and vehicles Short for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2–6, with Bolt the little tow truck.

A fire truck carries long ladders on top. Some ladders can reach as high as a ten-story building! It also carries hoses, and lots and lots of water to spray. Firefighters use it to help keep everyone safe.

title: Excavators Can Spin All the Way Around!
description:
Excavators Can Spin All the Way Around! An excavator's cab sits on a turntable, so it can spin all the way around!

title: Why Are School Buses Yellow?
description:

title: Why Does the Cement Mixer Keep Spinning?
description:
Why Does the Cement Mixer Keep Spinning? Inside is wet concrete. Spinning keeps it mixed, so it doesn't get hard too soon.
A quick trucks and vehicles Short for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2–6, with Bolt the little tow truck.

Inside is wet concrete. Spinning keeps it mixed, so it doesn't get hard too soon. When it gets to the building spot, the concrete slides out of a chute. Concrete dries hard to make sidewalks and roads.
